title: Regulatory Assets and Regulatory Liabilities
summary: Requires recognition of regulatory assets and regulatory liabilities for rate-regulated activities, superseding IFRS 14 Regulatory Deferral Accounts.

bannerNotice.title: Brand-new Standard – Effective 1 January 2029
bannerNotice.body: IFRS 20 was issued on 27 May 2026 and becomes effective for annual periods beginning on or after 1 January 2029, with early adoption permitted. It supersedes IFRS 14 Regulatory Deferral Accounts.
